gazette.sourceBody: Form {form}: transcribed verbatim from the English edition of Gazette Extraordinary 1886/58 of 2014-10-31 ({pages} pages). A transcription, not a lawyer-approved template. Only the blanks can be filled.
gazette.localOnly: Typed blanks are saved on this device only until the draft API can store them.
gazette.selectBlank: Select a blank on the form to review it.
gazette.notOnFormBody: The template records these fields, but the printed gazette form has no blank for them.
gazette.fieldMissing: This blank's field is not on the generated form.
gazette.noRendering: No gazette rendering exists for this template yet, so its fields are reviewed one by one.

unresolvedReason.NO_FACT: No verified fact supplies this field yet.
unresolvedReason.FACT_NOT_CONFIRMED: A fact exists but a lawyer has not confirmed it.
unresolvedReason.FACT_SUPERSEDED: The fact was replaced by a newer version.
unresolvedReason.BLOCKED_BY_ISSUE: An open issue blocks this field.

gazette.criticalNote: Critical particulars come from confirmed facts. They can be confirmed or cleared here, never typed onto the form.
gazette.reasonHint: Why this decision is being recorded

refused.APPROVED_FORM_IMMUTABLE: An approved form cannot be changed. Amend it as a new form version.
refused.UNKNOWN_FIELD: That field is not on this form.
refused.FIELD_NOT_POPULATED: There is no value to confirm yet.
refused.REASON_REQUIRED: Give a reason for this decision.
refused.CRITICAL_FIELD_REQUIRES_CONFIRMED_FACT: A critical field is confirmed from a verified fact, never typed.
refused.LAWYER_AUTHORED_TEXT_NOT_PERMITTED: This template does not allow lawyer-written text in that field.
